lines.es: Hola, buenos días. ¿Es aquí la clase de cocina?
lines.en: Hi, good morning. Is the cooking class here?
Yes! Welcome. What's your name?

lines.es: Me llamo Marina. Es mi primera clase.
lines.en: My name is Marina. It's my first class.
Nice to meet you, Marina. Are you nervous?

lines.es: Un poco nerviosa, pero también contenta.
lines.en: A little nervous, but also happy.

lines.es: Tranquila. Hoy preparamos una tortilla de patatas.
lines.en: Don't worry. Today we're making a Spanish omelette.
Great! What do we need?

lines.es: Huevos, patatas, cebolla y aceite de oliva.
lines.en: Eggs, potatoes, onion and olive oil.
OK. Where do I leave my bag?

lines.es: Aquí, en la silla. Y ponte este delantal blanco.
lines.en: Here, on the chair. And put on this white apron.
Thanks. Do I wash my hands first?

lines.es: Sí, con agua y jabón. Muy bien.
lines.en: Yes, with soap and water. Very good.
OK, I'm starting!
Hi, my name is Laura. Are you new?
Yes, hi. I'm Marina. And you?

lines.es: Yo también soy nueva en la clase.
lines.en: I'm new in the class too.

lines.es: ¡Qué bien! Ya no estoy tan nerviosa.
lines.en: Great! I'm not so nervous now.
Mmm! Everything smells good.

lines.es: Sí. Las patatas se cocinan despacio.
lines.en: Yes. The potatoes are cooking slowly.
Will you cut the onion?

lines.es: Vale. La corto despacio, con cuidado.
lines.en: OK. I'll cut it slowly, carefully.

lines.es: Yo bato los huevos en el bol.
lines.en: I'll beat the eggs in the bowl.
Perfect. Do you cook a lot at home?

lines.es: No mucho. Por eso quiero aprender.
lines.en: Not much. That's why I want to learn.
Me too. I'm curious!
Well then, let's cook!

lines.es: Ahora, con cuidado. Coge un plato grande.
lines.en: Now, carefully. Take a large plate.
This plate?
Yes. Put it over the frying pan.
OK. And now?
Now, flip it over. Quickly!
Oh! A piece is breaking off. What a mess!

lines.es: No pasa nada. Es normal la primera vez.
lines.en: It doesn't matter. It's normal the first time.
What do I do now?

lines.es: Pon la tortilla otra vez en la sartén.
lines.en: Put the omelette back in the frying pan.
Shall we cook it a little more?
Yes. Look, it's golden now.

lines.es: No es redonda, pero está hecha.
lines.en: It's not round, but it's cooked.

lines.es: ¡Por fin! Vamos a probar la tortilla.
lines.en: At last! Let's try the omelette.

lines.es: Sí. Pruebo un trozo… ¡Está de muerte!
lines.en: Yes. I'll try a piece… It's amazing!

lines.es: ¡Es verdad! Está caliente y muy rica.
lines.en: It's true! It's hot and very tasty.
It isn't perfect, but it's delicious!

lines.es: Cocinar con amigos es muy bonito.
lines.en: Cooking with friends is lovely.
Yes. I feel good here.
What are you writing in your notebook?

lines.es: Apunto las palabras nuevas: sartén, bol, delantal…
lines.en: I'm noting down the new words: frying pan, bowl, apron…
Good idea! Are you coming to another class?
Of course! I want another class.
Me too. Well… see you soon, Marina!
See you soon, Laura!

narr.intro: [excited] Welcome! [cheerfully] Today, practise real conversations from Marina's first Spanish cooking class! [warmly] First listen... then repeat each line.
narr.c1: [cheerfully] Conversation one: arriving at the class!
narr.c4: [cheerfully] Conversation four: at the long table!
narr.outro: [excited] Well done! [warmly] See you next week!
